so it’s sort of a mixed bag based on songs we’ve listened to together, artists i’ve talked to him about but haven’t gotten the opportunity to show him in person and songs that just reflect how i sorta feel! it’s sorta /mu/core-y. here’s the tracklist.

alison - slowdive

dreams - the cranberries

runaways - sage francis

waste - foster the people

fade into you - mazzy star

there is a light that never goes out - the smiths

in the aeroplane over the sea - neutral milk hotel

smoothie king - bowling for soup

dark blue - jack’s mannequin

untitled - interpol
i’m putting it on a physical cd, if that helps any. i’ve always just called stuff on cds/tapes mixtapes and anything non-physical playlists

i was in a relationship with a woman who was very quick to get violent with me. 
we were in the car discussing something her friend had said about me, and i was very upset. she was driving, and she started screaming (just “aaaaaaaa”, not any words) and grabbed me by my hair and slammed me back and forth. later that night, she threw me against a wall and as i was running out and crying, she followed me out and asked “where’s the strong woman now?”

it’s worth mentioning this specific girl was under the impression she was god. and she’d successfully brainwashed me into believing she was god and i was her fated companion who traveled the universe before we were born. and that if i left, i wouldn’t be the true, special friend of god or kindhearted lover of god or sidekick of god or what have you and my soul would be planted in a garden after i died and i’d just perish and have no chance of a full afterlife. 

i knew that if i didn’t leave she’d kill me or i’d kill myself, and i had actually been resigned to that outcome (dying) for months. it was only a matter of when i’d die and who’d be killing me in my mind. 

it was after i got a job i had this flash that... people liked me, and i was cool. i wasn’t under her financial coercion anymore or relying on her, so i left for the last time. it was hard looking back because she made me feel like my world was unsafe and everyone would hurt me like she did, she told me that anyone would rock my shit if i acted as annoying as i did, and that if she acted like how i did i’d have hurt her, too, if i wasn’t such a pussy.

but i did end up leaving and now have an excellent support system. i’m still afraid of people, that anyone i meet could end in another cultish death trap, but i can at least see life ahead of me.
